description: Defines configuration structures, enums, and classes for the SDR Radio Unit in a wireless communication system, including expert settings, thread profiles, logging, and frequency parameters.

classes.name: ru_sdr_unit_expert_config
classes.description: Configuration for expert SDR radio unit parameters such as throttling and transmission mode.

classes.name: amplitude_control_unit_config
classes.description: Configuration for amplitude control including gain backoff, power ceiling, and clipping.

classes.name: ru_sdr_unit_logger_config
classes.description: Logging configuration for radio and physical layer levels.

classes.name: ru_sdr_unit_cpu_affinities_cell_config
classes.description: CPU affinity configuration for radio unit workers per cell.

classes.name: ru_sdr_unit_expert_threads_config
classes.description: Configuration of thread profiles for the SDR radio unit, with automatic profile selection based on CPU count.

classes.name: ru_sdr_unit_expert_execution_config
classes.description: Expert execution configuration including thread profiles and CPU affinities per cell.

classes.name: ru_sdr_unit_metrics_config
classes.description: Metrics configuration including enabling/disabling metrics collection.

classes.name: ru_sdr_unit_config
classes.description: Main configuration structure for the SDR radio unit, including frequency, gains, clock, and expert settings.
